body.purpose: Actions, tab titles, and supporting interface text.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Separate transient operation feedback from the popup content.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Subtle hover and feedback transitions; reduced-motion preference shortens them.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The leading action in the popup.
components.css: .ds-primary { height: 38px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; color: #fff; background: #176d50; font: 700 11px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #12563f; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a7d6b7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A secondary action alongside the primary organize control.
components.css: .ds-secondary { height: 38px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #e5eae5; border-radius: 9px; color: #1d2925; background: #fff; font: 700 11px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #cddbd0; background: #fbfdfb; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a7d6b7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Search
components.description: Searches open tabs by title or website.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 35px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #e4e9e4; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #90bca0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e9f4ec; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #1d2925; background: transparent; font: 400 11px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #68746b; } .ds-search kbd { border: 1px solid #e5e9e4; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 5px; color: #68746b; background: #fff; font: 9px system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The popup is a small working surface for sorting and returning to browser pages. Its visual language borrows from a tidy filing desk: a light paper-like canvas, dark readable type, ruled section boundaries, and a leaf-green action color. The compact utility layout keeps the tabs themselves—not decoration—at the center.

Controls stay familiar and direct. Site initials stand in for remote favicon loading, saved workspaces read as simple rows, and empty states explain the next useful action.
keyCharacteristics: Green primary actions on a light neutral ground
Fine dividers instead of stacked dashboard cards
dos: Do keep open tabs and saved workspaces as the main content.
Do use local browser storage and avoid external assets or service calls.
Do preserve clear focus states and readable supporting text.
donts: Don't add remote favicons, fonts, or decorative imagery to the popup.
Don't turn the tab list into a stack of generic cards.
